source_refs.note: 4. Class Amphibia: a main subheading of 1.5 Classification of vertebrates, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 24-25.

blocks.text: Yeh tetrapods ki pehli class hai. In mein haddi ka endoskeleton hota hai. Machhliyon ke baraks amphibians ki gardan (neck) hoti hai: pehla vertebra (cervical vertebra) khopri ke pichhle hisse ke saath harkat karta hai aur khopri ko upar neeche hilne deta hai. Jild hamwar (scales ke baghair) aur nam hoti hai. Yeh gases ke tabadle, temperature control, aur paani jazb karne aur jama rakhne mein madad karti hai. Dil double-circuit aur teen chambers wala hai: do atria aur ek ventricle. Larva ki stage mein yeh gills se, aur baalig ho kar lungs aur jild se saans lete hain. Yeh garmi ke liye bahar ke zariye (external heat source) par chalte hain, is liye ectotherms hain. Yeh apne jism ka temperature control nahi kar sakte aur use ek jaisa nahi rakh sakte; is liye yeh poikilothermic (badalte temperature wale) janwar hain aur sardiyon mein hibernate karte hain (lambi neend so jate hain). Salamander, newts aur mud puppies dum wale amphibians hain; mendak (frogs) aur toads bina dum ke; aur caecilians bina taangon ke. Amphibians unisexual hain. Fertilization aam taur par external hoti hai.
